# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game titled **Ringlight Zombie Shooter: Neo Horde Poggers** from this steering prompt: Zombie Shooter. A satirical game inspired by Sonic built around zombie shooter play, with competitive, futuristic, leaderboard energy, after work session design, search-friendly hooks like zombie shooter, shooter, survival, aesthetics like neon noir, shonen aesthetic, neon aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as chad, poggers. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Preserve the implemented shooter mechanics: a scope/drag mode for finding a trait-matched alpha zombie, a survival-run mode with joystick-style drag movement, FIRE button shooting, ammo/signal pressure, wrong-shot horde panic, target kill, win/loss overlays, and restart/menu flow. Rebuild presentation as a neon noir shonen city: blue-quill chad courier protagonist, mutated zombies with readable jacket/rot traits, ring-road background motifs, leaderboard feed HUD, compact mobile controls, and meme-tone hit/miss feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: browser-native arcade shooter / target-identification survival game
- objective: identify the unique alpha zombie by visual traits, shoot it, then either win immediately in Scope Shooter or escape after the kill in Survival Run.
- input model: one-thumb compatible drag on canvas to move scope/courier plus a large FIRE button; menu and restart buttons remain native tap/click controls.
- core loop: start mode, scan neon city, compare HUD clues to zombie traits, fire, receive hit/miss feedback, then win or handle horde pressure.
- fail/friction state: wrong shots panic the horde; Survival Run can lose through low signal or infected escort contact; retry/menu restore the loop.

## Protected Mechanics
- Preserve two modes, drag-to-pan scope, drag-to-move joystick, FIRE button shooting, hit box checks, ammo/signal updates, target kill win/escape semantics, wrong-target penalties, and restart/menu states.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, focal silhouettes, zombie drawings, city background motifs, particles, fonts, button styling, feedback copy, GIF reaction lane, and procedural rings/quills can change without altering rules.
